sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 752
PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 752
ORDINANCE XXIV OF 2021
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH INSTITUTIONS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2021
An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Medical and
Health Institutions Act, 2003
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
14th October, 2021]
No.
Legis:13-24/2021, dated 14.10.2021.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published
for general information:
It
is necessary to amend the Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Act, 2003 (IX
of 2003) to make provisions for the purposes hereinafter appearing.
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be cited as the Punjab Medical and Health Institutions
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2021.
(2) This
Ordinance shall come into force at once.

action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
2. Substitution
of section 2 of Act IX of 2003.---In
the Punjab Medical and Health Institution Act, 2003 (IX of 2003), for brevity
referred to as 'the Act' for section 2, the following shall be substituted:
2. Definitions.---In this Act:
(a) "Board"
means the Board of Management of a Medical Institution and its Health
Institutions;
(b) "Department"
means the Specialized Healthcare and Medical Education Department of the
Government;
(c) "Government"
means Government of the Punjab;
(d) "Head"
means the administrative head of a Medical Institution, and includes the
Principal, Dean or the Executive Director of the Medical Institution;
(e) "Health
Institution" means a hospital with or without a training centre, a
laboratory or a medical facility notified under this Act;
(f) "Institution"
refers to Medical Institution and Health Institution together;
(g) "Medical
Institution" means a Medical College or a Medical Institute along with the
attached hospital(s) and training centre(s) notified under this Act;
(h) "Nomination
Committee" means the Committee constituted under this Act for making
nominations of a panel of three persons for appointment of members of the Board
in each category of non-official members;
(i) "prescribed"
means prescribed by the rules made under this Act;
(j) "public
areas" includes the premises of a hospital frequently visited by the
patients or their attendants, but does not include the hostels and offices
regardless of being situated in the hospital;
(k) "Select
Committee" means the Select Committee constituted by the Chief Minister
for carrying out functions under the provisions of sections 7 and 8 of this
Act; and
(l) "Special
Selection Board" means the Board constituted under this Act for selection
and recommendation of employees in the service of an Institution.".

pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
6. Substitution
of section 7 of Act IX of 2003.---In
the Act, for section 7, the following shall be substituted:
"7.
Head of Medical Institution.---(1) The Chief Minister shall appoint a whole
time Head of a Medical Institution from a panel of three serving Professors of
the teaching cadre of the Department on such qualification, terms and
conditions as may be approved by him, on the recommendation of the Select
Committee, which shall select the candidates through a competitive process
pursuant to an advertisement for this post by the Dapartment through any means.
(2)
The Head shall exercise such powers and perform such functions as may be
prescribed.
(3)
The Head shall be appointed for a period of three years and may be re-appointed
as such if found eligible through the competitive process given in subsection
(1).
(4)
The Chief Minister may transfer or remove the Head of a Medical institution at
any time on administrative or any other grounds.".

Superintendent.---(1) An officer of the Department or the Primary and
Secondary Healthcare Department of the Government shall be appointed as Medical

13. Amendment
of section 14 of Act IX of 2003.---In
the Act, in section 14, for subsection (2), the following shall be substituted:
"(2)
The fund shall be kept in such custody and shall be utilized and regulated in
the following manner:
(a)
Not more than forty percent of the fund receipts in a given financial year
shall be utilized for disbursement of salaries to the employees of the Board
mentioned in section 9;
(b)
Not less than forty percent of the fund receipts in a given financial year
shall be utilized for expenditure on improvement, installation, refurbishment
and establishment of infrastructure and facilities in the public areas of the
hospital, particularly the emergency department, in-patient department,
out-patient department, and open spaces:
Provided
that any increase or decrease, as the case may be, in the expenditure from the

Provided
further that the provisions of this section shall take effect from 1st of July
2021.
(3)
The Board shall make decisions for rational utilization of the moneys out of
the fund keeping in view the shortfall of the regular budget receipts from the
Government.".

"15.

"16.

(3)

subsection (1).".
